summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.content: Full Stack Developer with experience since 2021 building modern, scalable web applications and microservice architectures. I build high-performance responsive portals and interfaces with React.js, Vite, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, as well as backend solutions with Node.js, Python, .NET, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. My experience includes RESTful APIs, WebSockets, automated testing, technical documentation, Design Systems, Puppeteer crawlers and scrapers, AI and LLM data pipelines, AWS and Azure, RabbitMQ, Kafka, CI/CD, Docker, Git, and code reviews.
